q1.explanationZh: pearl“珍珠”，可数名词，a string of pearls“一串珍珠”。

q2.explanationZh: peculiar“奇怪的；独特的”，注意拼写 pe-cu-li-ar。

q3.explanationZh: pedestrian 既是名词“行人”，也是形容词“步行的”，pedestrian crossing“人行横道”。

q4.explanationZh: peer“同龄人；同辈”，常用复数 peers。

q5.explanationZh: pen“钢笔、圆珠笔等笔”，in pen“用钢笔写”。

q7.explanationZh: penguin“企鹅”，注意 n 后面是 gu。

q8.explanationZh: penny“便士”，复数 pennies 或 pence。

q9.explanationZh: pension 名词“养老金”，动词“发给养老金”，pension sb. off“让某人领养老金退休”。

q10.explanationZh: people“人们”，表示“人们”时是复数概念；表示“民族”时可数。

q11.explanationZh: pepper“胡椒粉；甜椒”，中间是双写 pp。

q12.explanationZh: per“每，每一”，3 dollars per kilogram“每公斤 3 美元”。

q13.explanationZh: perceive“察觉；意识到”，注意 -ceive 的拼写（e 在 i 前）。

q14.explanationZh: percent 也可写作 per cent，与基数词连用，60 percent“百分之六十”。

q15.explanationZh: percentage“百分比；比例”，前面不跟具体数字，如 the percentage of girls。

q16.explanationZh: perfect 形容词“完美的”，动词“使完美”，重音不同。

q18.explanationZh: perform 加 -ance 构成名词 performance“表演；表现”。

q20.explanationZh: period“一段时间”，a period of time“一段时间”。

q22.explanationZh: permit 的名词形式 permission“允许”，不可数。

q23.explanationZh: permit 动词“允许”，名词“许可证”，permit sb. to do sth.“允许某人做某事”。

q24.explanationZh: persevere 的名词形式 perseverance“毅力”，结尾是 -ance。

q25.explanationZh: persevere“坚持不懈”，不及物动词，后接 in/with/at sth.。

q26.explanationZh: persist“坚持；执意”，persist in doing sth.“坚持做某事”。

q27.explanationZh: person“人”，可数名词，形容词是 personal。

q28.explanationZh: person 加 -al 构成形容词 personal“个人的”。

q29.explanationZh: personal 加 -ity 构成名词 personality“个性”。

q30.explanationZh: perspective“视角；观点”，from every perspective“从各个角度”。

q31.explanationZh: persuade“说服”，persuade sb. to do sth.“说服某人做某事”。

q32.explanationZh: pessimistic“悲观的”，反义词 optimistic“乐观的”。

q33.explanationZh: pet“宠物”，也可作定语，pet dogs“宠物狗”。

q35.explanationZh: peculiar“奇怪的”，sound 可数，前加 a。

q36.explanationZh: pedestrian 作定语“行人的”，pedestrian crossing“人行横道”。

q38.explanationZh: a period of time“一段时间”。

q39.explanationZh: permit 后直接跟动作时用动名词：permit doing sth.。

q40.explanationZh: 有宾语时用不定式：permit sb. to do sth.。

q41.explanationZh: persevere 是不及物动词，后接介词 in / with / at。

q42.explanationZh: persist in doing sth.“坚持做某事”，in 后用动名词。

q43.explanationZh: persuade sb. of sth.“使某人相信某事”，介词用 of。

q44.explanationZh: persuade sb. to do sth.“说服某人做某事”，后接不定式。

q45.explanationZh: persuade 后可接 that 从句，表示“使相信……”。

q47.explanationZh: 被动结构 be persuaded by“被……说服”。

q48.explanationZh: peer“同龄人”，答案书印作 in peers；表示“在……之中”更常用 among peers。

q49.explanationZh: three strings of 后接可数名词复数，pearls“珍珠”。

q50.explanationZh: “他父亲是个农民”，peasant“农民”，a 后用单数。

q51.explanationZh: few 后接可数名词复数，peers“能与之匹敌的人”。

q52.explanationZh: be pensioned off“领养老金退休”，被动语态用过去分词 pensioned。

q53.explanationZh: Mary’s 后接名词，单数 has 对应 performance“表演”。

q54.explanationZh: 数字后用 percent，表示“百分之六十”，percent 不加 s。

q55.explanationZh: don’t 后用动词原形，permit sb. to do sth.“允许某人做某事”。

q56.explanationZh: 修饰名词 information 用形容词 personal“个人的”。

q57.explanationZh: are ... by 是被动语态，用过去分词 persuaded“被诱导”。

q58.explanationZh: pet 作定语修饰 dogs，pet dogs“宠物狗”。

q59.explanationZh: a multicultural 后接单数名词，perspective“视角”。

q60.sampleAnswer: Please remember: in the face of difficulties and challenges, perseverance and patience can help us overcome them and lead us to success.
references: Please remember: in the face of difficulties and challenges, perseverance and patience can help us overcome them and lead us to success.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “坚持”用名词 perseverance 作主语；“面对”= in the face of，help sb. do sth.。

q61.sampleAnswer: From every perspective, writing is a skill that offers nothing but benefits and applies to every ordinary person.
references: From every perspective, writing is a skill that offers nothing but benefits and applies to every ordinary person.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “从各个方面看”= from every perspective；“只有好处”= offer nothing but benefits，用定语从句修饰 skill。

q62.sampleAnswer: If you persevere in your studies, you are sure to make great progress.
references: If you persevere in your studies, you are sure to make great progress.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “取得很大进步”= make great progress，progress 不可数；“坚持”= persevere in；be sure to do“一定会”。

q63.sampleAnswer: We are grateful to you for your permission to reproduce this article.
references: We are grateful to you for your permission to reproduce this article.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “感谢某人某事”= be grateful to sb. for sth.；permission to do sth.“允许做某事”。

q64.sampleAnswer: Researchers are studying penguins to understand the impacts of climate change on their habitat.
references: Researchers are studying penguins to understand the impacts of climate change on their habitat.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: 泛指企鹅用复数 penguins；“正在研究”用现在进行时；不定式 to understand 表目的。

q65.sampleAnswer: The percentage of girls in engineering has increased substantially.
references: The percentage of girls in engineering has increased substantially.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “……的比例”= the percentage of ...，作主语时谓语用单数 has increased。

q66.sampleAnswer: We perfected a hand-signal system so that he could keep me informed of hazards.
references: We perfected a hand-signal system so that he could keep me informed of hazards.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: perfect 作动词“完善”，用过去式 perfected；so that 引导目的状语从句，keep sb. informed of sth.“随时告知某人”。

q67.sampleAnswer: The search has lasted several days, so there’s no possibility that the missing people are still alive.
references: The search has lasted several days, so there’s no possibility that the missing people are still alive.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: people 表示“人们”是复数，谓语用 are；possibility 后接 that 同位语从句。

q68.sampleAnswer: Pedestrians are scarcely seen except for school hours when the traffic should always yield to children and pedestrians.
references: Pedestrians are scarcely seen except for school hours when the traffic should always yield to children and pedestrians.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “行人”用复数 pedestrians；scarcely“几乎不”；when 引导定语从句修饰 school hours，yield to“让路”。

q69.sampleAnswer: If you two want to cooperate, you must be clearly aware that you can’t change the personality of the other but should learn to respect each other.
references: If you two want to cooperate, you must be clearly aware that you can’t change the personality of the other but should learn to respect each other.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “个性”= personality；be aware that ...“意识到……”；not ... but ...“不是……而是……”。
